'''Darred Eloinie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of [[Eloinie Petro-Munitions]], an armaments company that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaraksander]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Eloinie's daughter [[Cyrstas Eloinie]] was kidnapped by the [[Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites]] movement and the group demanded that he pay a ransom of 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for her return. Rather than pay up, Eloinie hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Valken Gresh]] to rescue Cyrstas.
